messages:
maria: FYI helm chart lint started failing for gpu pools in eu-west. CI shows validators tripping on values that used to be fine.

jason: seen this. error looks like values.schema.json is rejecting empty nodeSelector maps we intentionally use for dynamic scheduling.

ci-bot: helm chart lint: charts/inference/ --values=env/prod.yaml
```
Error: values.schema.json: 'nodeSelector' should be object with at least one key but got {}
Recommended: add 'anyOf' to allow empty map when 'enableGpuScheduling' = false
```

liam: are we accidentally forcing nodeSelector when `tolerations` exist? a lot of teams rely on taints+tolerations instead of explicit nodeSelector for GPU placement.

anya: I dug in. our schema has this rule: `nodeSelector: { type: object, minProperties: 1 }` which fails for empty map. We should either allow `{}` or gate the requirement behind `enableGpuScheduling: true`.

maria: proposal: make schema conditional so that when `scheduling.type == \"taint\"` nodeSelector can be empty. also add a helper to coalesce nodeSelector + nodeAffinity in templates.

kelly: +1. minProperties causing churn across regions where labels differ (e.g. eu-west uses `gpu.instance=g4`, us-west uses `gpu.family=A100`). letting teams omit nodeSelector is nicer.

anya: here is a small schema patch I tested locally:
```
"nodeSelector": {
  "anyOf": [
    { "type": "object" },
    { "type": "null" }
  ]
},
"required": ["scheduling"]
```
Then add a top-level conditional: if `scheduling.type == \"explicit\"` require `minProperties: 1` on nodeSelector.

jason: can we also catch template runtime errors? helm template used to blow up when helpers returned `nil` for an empty map. maybe add `default` and `toYaml` guards in helpers: `{{- $ns := default dict .Values.nodeSelector }}`.

liam: exact helper fix I used in a pod anti-affinity helper: `{{- $ns := .Values.nodeSelector | default (dict) }}` then `{{- if gt (len $ns) 0 }}` emit `nodeSelector`. this prevents nil render.

ci-bot: quick lint run on anya's branch: charts/inference@pr-482
```
helm lint: SUCCESS (templates render)
kubeval: pass
helm test: skipped (no cluster)
```

maria: sweet. two actionable items: 1) merge conditional schema change, 2) patch helpers to use `default (dict)` and add unit tests in chart-ci job to run `helm template` with empty maps and with taints-only configs.

kelly: I'll open the follow-up PR for chart-ci tests. also add a short note in the chart README about scheduling modes (explicit vs taint).

jason: one more gotcha: our GitOps validator enforces schema on repo pushes. make sure the branch includes updated values.schema.json in the same commit so the validator doesn't block merge.

anya: noted. I'll push the schema + helper change together. leaving a TODO to add region examples (eu-west, us-west) so teams can copy-paste.

maria: thanks all. major win if we can stop interrupts from the GPU infra team at 3pm every other week :slightly_smiling_face:

liam: :thumbsup:
